title: Mä Profetar Laykux Dedicado Voces ukanaka
intro: Jayankir mä jachʼa markanjja, mä jachʼa yatiyiriw uka tiempon apnaqerinakan wali qhoru apanukut uñjasïna. Ukampirus mä jisk’a muyuw Diosar katuyata almanakax aka Allah luqtiripan jak’apan sayt’asipxäna, mä divin jawsatapar jaysañ wal munapxäna. Jupanakan jan jaytjasis iyawsäwipax mä ch’aman markaruw t’aqanuqtaspa ukat qhiparux jan iyawsir ch’amanakaruw atipt’aspa.
clues: Mä jiskʼa tamaw Diosar taqe chuyma servipjjayäta, iyawsäwinsa ukat mä amtampis mayachtʼatäpjjayätwa.
Mä jachʼa yatiyiri jakʼan saytʼasipjjayäta, juparojj oraqen wali chʼamani autoridadanakan apanukutänwa.
Kunawsatix aka yatiyirix jiskt’äna: ‘¿Khitinakas Allah thakhin yanapirinakajaxa?’ sasa. jan pächasisaw jaysapxta.
Aka yatiyirirux alaxpachat mä manq’äw thaqhañapatakiw mayipxta, chuymanakajar chuymacht’añataki.
Uka pachan jaqinak taypinx yaqhipanakax jiwasan yatiyawis tuqiw iyawsapxäna ukatx yaqhipanakax qala chuymampiw jan iyawsapkänti, ukampis Allah jupax iyawsirinakaruw ch’amanchawayi.
Jiwasax Hawawariyyun — Isa ukan taqi chuyma arkirinakapawa, Allah ukan yanapt’apampiw atipt’apxi.

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
